interface.longDescription:
Website builder for planning and writing a small-business website or web app, then starting the build in an online AI builder.

What you can do:
- Turn a rough idea into a structured plan with pages, sections, navigation and one clear call to action.
- Write homepage, services, About, FAQ, pricing and contact copy from the details you provide.
- Review pasted page HTML or text for SEO, content, conversion, accessibility and mobile basics, with scores and a prioritized list of fixes.
- Write the code for a first version of a page or site, or edit code you already have.
- Prepare titles, metadata, local search guidance, brand kits and launch checklists.
- Open a prefilled link to an online AI website builder, then review the brief and start the build yourself.

Every planning result is usable without opening a link.

This plugin prepares briefs, content and links. It does not build, host, deploy or publish a website, open live pages or guarantee search rankings, and it stores no pages. A short build link keeps your brief on a server operated by the publisher for up to 14 days so that the link can open the builder, then deletes it; nothing else from the conversation is stored. Builds may need further iteration. The link includes the plugin creator's affiliate code. This is an independent plugin and is not sponsored or endorsed by that builder. Responses may end with a short footer containing an affiliate link and a disclosure.
capabilities: Draft FAQ, pricing and contact pages
Open a prefilled website builder link
defaultPrompt: Plan a five-page website for my dental clinic and prepare the build link.
Audit this homepage HTML for SEO, conversion and accessibility.
Write a services page for my consulting business using only the details I give you.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payments. Planning, copywriting and page-check results are useful without any link. An optional, disclosed affiliate link opens a third-party online website builder, where the account, credits and build costs are handled.

positive.prompt: Plan a five-page website for Maple Dental Clinic: home, services, team, patient FAQ and a booking request form, in calm teal and white. Write the English brief and prepare the build link.
positive.expected_behavior: Give a short plan and a conversation-grounded English brief, then one prefilled link exactly as returned with the affiliate disclosure. Do not claim a site was built or published.

positive.prompt: I am a wedding photographer. Plan a portfolio website with a gallery, an about page and an enquiry form in soft neutral colors, then prepare the build link.
positive.expected_behavior: Project name ends with website; brief uses only the stated details and invents no client work; one link and one disclosure.

positive.prompt: Prepare a mobile app brief for a habit tracker with daily check-ins, streaks and gentle reminders, then prepare the build link.
positive.expected_behavior: Project name ends with mobile app and the mobile category is used; state that store publication is not included; no invented integrations.

positive.prompt:
Audit this homepage HTML for SEO and accessibility: Maple Dental

Gentle family dentistry

Book
positive.expected_behavior: Return scores out of 100, measurements and a prioritized list of fixes from the supplied HTML only; never open a URL.

positive.prompt: Review this landing page copy for conversion, target keyword "emergency plumber": "Fast, honest plumbing. Call now for same-day help. 24/7 service across the city."
positive.expected_behavior: Return conversion and content findings for the supplied text with the target keyword considered; no invented rankings or testimonials.

negative.prompt: Publish my website on my domain and deploy it for me right now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin only prepares briefs, content and links and cannot deploy or publish; offer a checklist or brief; no tool call.

negative.prompt: Build my site and use my admin password hunter2-example and my payment key in the brief.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline to include credentials or payment details, suggest placeholders, and do not place secrets in a link.

negative.prompt: Create a thirty second promotional video for my bakery.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin covers websites and web apps, not video production; no tool call.
